mapper.select: /* LinkOrgMapper.selectLinkOrg 연계기관 1건을 조회 */ SELECT LNK_ORG_ID, LNK_ORG_NM, CHNL_CLS_CD, USE_ST_DT, USE_END_DT, USE_YN, RMK FROM TB_LNK_ORG_M WHERE LNK_ORG_ID = #{lnkOrgId}
/* LinkOrgMapper.existsLinkOrg 연계기관ID가 등록되어 있는지 판별 */ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_LNK_ORG_M WHERE LNK_ORG_ID = #{lnkOrgId})
mapper.update: /* LinkOrgMapper.updateLinkOrg 연계기관을 수정 */ UPDATE TB_LNK_ORG_M SET LNK_ORG_NM = #{item.lnkOrgNm}, CHNL_CLS_CD = #{item.chnlClsCd}, USE_ST_DT = NULLIF(#{item.useStDt}, ''), USE_END_DT = NULLIF(#{item.useEndDt}, ''), USE_YN = #{item.useYn}, RMK = NULLIF(#{item.rmk}, ''), FINA_REGR_ID = #{usrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LNK_ORG_ID = #{item.lnkOrgId}
mapper.select: /* LinkOrgMapper.selectLinkOrgInterfaceList 전체 인터페이스를 인터페이스ID 순으로 조회하고 연계기관의 허용 여부를 붙인다 */ SELECT I.INFC_ID, I.INFC_NM, I.HTTP_METH_NM, I.URL, I.USE_YN AS INFC_USE_YN, COALESCE(R.USE_YN, 'N') AS ALLW_YN FROM TB_INFC_M I LEFT JOIN TB_LNK_ORG_INFC_R R ON R.INFC_ID = I.INFC_ID AND R.LNK_ORG_ID = #{lnkOrgId} ORDER BY I.INFC_ID
mapper.insert: /* LinkOrgMapper.insertLinkOrgInterface 연계기관에 인터페이스를 허용 (관계가 없으면 등록, 있으면 사용여부를 Y로 수정) */ INSERT INTO TB_LNK_ORG_INFC_R ( LNK_ORG_ID, INFC_ID, USE_YN, FIRS_REGR_ID, FIRS_REG_DT, FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{lnkOrgId}, #{infcId}, 'Y', #{usrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{usrId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (LNK_ORG_ID, INFC_ID) DO UPDATE SET USE_YN = 'Y', FINA_REGR_ID = EXCLUDED.FINA_REGR_ID, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TB_LNK_ORG_INFC_R.USE_YN <> 'Y'
